voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Devon, England, February eighteen fifty-five. After heavy snow, people woke to lines of small hoof-shaped prints.
Mostly in single file, about four inches long. Reports said they crossed rooftops and high walls.
They were reported in more than thirty places, on both sides of the Exe estuary. Some said the Devil had walked.
One letter at the time claimed a trail ran a hundred miles in a night. The farthest anyone is known to have followed one was about five.
Donkeys, wood mice, a runaway balloon, a hoax. All remain theories. None explains every mark.
